items.comments: We had a wonderful time staying in the Penthouse. The beds were comfortable, the view was spectacular, and the building management staff was accommodating and friendly. I recommend Sea to Sky and staying at this lovely place.
Everything was available and ready to go for us. Could not have been better.
The apartment was excellent.  I was there with a number of coworkers and it was a great space for multiple people to live and sleep for a few days!
Had a great time.... Views were spectacular!!! Walking distance to everything we wanted to do. Highly recommend!!!!
